title: Unique Umami Venezuelan Chicken Skewers
description: Savory Venezuelan dish featuring caster sugar and wok-hei, perfect for a low-glycemic diet, this recipe combines the energizing flavors of Venezuela with the sweetness of caster sugar.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, lime juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, and paprika.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
While the chicken is cooking, mix the caster sugar and 1 tablespoon of water in a small saucepan.
Bring the sugar mixture to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Brush the sugar glaze onto the chicken during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Serve the chicken skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
